question: What power arises from continually contemplating a smoke-colored form?
premises: The practitioner is instructed to contemplate a smoke-colored form always
This contemplation produces an effect on the triple world
The effect named is shaking the triple world
inference: By always contemplating a smoke-colored form, one can shake the triple world.
plain_english: O beloved, always contemplating a smoke-colored form, one can shake the triple world.
